= 5 cement

notes.title: Update V9.0
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

V9.0 is now live and ready to be played. This update is largely focused on optimization and under the hood stuff needed for future updates. I did however manage to sneak in a few bug fixes and changes that were bugging me. Below is a list of what can be found in this update. A new game will not be required. 

Please report all bugs via the “Bugs/Fixes Thread” here on Steam.

I would like to thank everyone for their patience in the last few months as no updates have been made. Much of the game code needed to be re worked in order for some of the roadmap features to be possible.

Cheers!

[b][u][i]PLEASE NOTE THAT SINCE NEW TREES HAVE BEEN ADDED, THEY MAY BE IN PLACES YOU DON'T WANT THEM, LIKE IN YOUR BASE LOL. YOU CAN HOWEVER SIMPLY CUT DOWN ANY UNWANTED ONES.[/i][/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31137298/1b30d1e3ef89f4020139a79f7c4b625d86238811.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31137298/cd39ccb16095572392a3ef3e4039a55eb4742c3a.jpg[/img]

[b][u][i]NEW LIGHTING AND TREES[/i][/u][/b]

Changes and modifications to the lighting, things will look crisper, brighter and more realistic. I have also swapped the old trees for newer better looking ones in my opinion.

There are 5 new tree types, 2 smallish ones and 3 larger ones. The 3 larger ones will all give 20 logs instead of 10. The 2 smaller ones will still give 10.

[b][u][i]OTHER THINGS ADDED OR CHANGED[/i][/u][/b]

- Lots of item craft time changes, many recipes will take a shorter time to craft. Such as, wood planks, ingots, arrows, just to name a few.

- One thing that always bugged me but only finally got around to adding is the ability to kill spiders with a knife, no more needing to use arrows or guns.

- I have also changed and removed some of the character animations. For example, you will no longer see any hands when not holding any weapons. 

- Also added to the character is a head bobble while walking and running.

- Another thing added based on community suggestions is a map marker for the first Stan quest. Previously players needed to locate him in one of the motels and many were struggling to do so. Now Stan will be identified on the map with a marker.

- Many bug fixes have also made it in this update.



Sorry for not adding much new content but this update is the first step to many cool things being added in the near future.

Thank you :)

notes.title: V8 Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

V8.01 is now live and ready to be played. This update is largely focused on a new Skills System feature but a few other things have been added also. Below is a list of what can be found in this update. A new game will not be required but is recommended.

Please report all bugs via the “Bugs/Fixes Thread” here on Steam.

Cheers!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31137298/e56004508747aab2b4fad709969d3d360f0bb311.jpg[/img]

ADDED - Skill System

A new Skill System has been added but is still in a work in progress state. These skills can be found by clicking on the newly added Skills tab in your inventory. There are 5 categories of skills, Crafting, Tools & Weapons, Player & Stats, Vehicles and Gear. Many skills have multiple levels and can be upgraded several times.

Players get XP points by completing tasks, killing AI, cutting trees and more. These XP points can be used to learn specific Skills.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31137298/4517a4c7779f823bd1a5965aad6cad8cde34e2e5.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31137298/1687d7a0c66cd57fe51b208b442c30bde7cc46fa.jpg[/img]

ADDED - Bunkers

2 Bunkers have been added to the map for now but I plan to add more in future updates. Both bunkers can only be accessed in single player quest mode as they are part of the quest line. However one of the bunkers can be used by players after completing one of the new late game quests.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31137298/a103b09afcebf2192367e075f58ce7021fee66f7.jpg[/img]

ADDED - More desert spots on Dead Island.

Many have been asking me to add more Cactus plants to obtain Prickly Pear (a great source of Carbohydrates) so I have added more desert spots with cactus on Dead Island.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31137298/e21e0263334230775671ebb90d6ab329c2e6c238.jpg[/img]

ADDED - Equipment Repair

Also a popular demand by the community was to allow the repair bench to also repair gear and equipment, it is now a possible thing.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31137298/a42bd52c8236db6c5101ffebf9685d4365a8c8cb.jpg[/img]

ADDED -  AI toggle damage

I have added the ability to play with AI but with no danger of them inflicting damage on players. Players can toggle AI damage off on new game creation but also in game on the pause menu.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31137298/5cbae9385f8a0f7a915798e6befe0ef6d14bd5d2.jpg[/img]

ADDED - 4 new Quests.

I have also added a few new quests, one of which allows you to build Market Stalls after completion. These stalls when placed in the world will allow AI Traders to move in. No more long travels to reach them. Another Quest will unlock the ability to use a bunker as a home base.

I am always working on more quests and will be adding more in the near future.

Some other things Added and Changed.

REMOVED - Titanium and Diamond Pickaxes
REMOVED - Titanium and Diamond Fireaxes
(These have been removed because of a skill to increase pickaxe and fireaxe damage)
REMOVED - Craftable Large Backpack to increase inventory space.
(Removed because of a new skill to increase inventory)
ADDED - Eating Sound
ADDED - Drinking Sound
ADDED - Healing Sound
CHANGE - Increased chances of Rain

notes.title: V7.0.2 Small Changes/Balancing
notes.content:
- Decreased the extraction timer of the Mineral Extractor from 3 minutes to 2 minutes.
- Previously, 1 to 3 units randomly would be extracted, I have increased it to 2 to 4 units instead.

The goal here is to give players a reason to build 10-15 + wind turbines and construct 3-4-5 Extractors with time but not make it too easy to obtain Ores either without lots of effort and hard work.

If anyone has any suggestions or comments about this feature, please do let me know in this post.

notes.title: Version 7.0.1 Update
notes.content:
Hi Everyone! 

This update is focused mainly on the continuation of the weather system but I have also changed the water shaders and added a new Mineral Extractor.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31137298/2481a55279c564ea27d771b1ca0826cd26789239.jpg[/img]
The weather system already included foggy days but now also includes rain. When it rains, the ground will start to look wet and in some spots may even consist of puddles. Currently it rains in all biomes but in future updates I will include snow and sand storms.

notes.title: V6.03 Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone, I have started to push some AI changes/fixes. You should now see a drastic improvement on AI getting stuck and their ability to shoot through walls and solid objects. Things may still not be 100% fixed so please report any AI still shooting through walls and getting stuck.

BUG FIX - Improved line of sight of the AI to no longer see players when behind solid objects. There may be a few POIs that they may see through walls still, if so please report them.
BUG FIX - Reduced forgiveness of the AI to just 5 seconds. This means that if the AI is running after you and you hide in a house or behind some solid object, after 5 seconds that AI will stop chase and resume wandering.
BUG FIX - Because AI should no longer see or detect players through walls, they should no longer shoot you through solid objects like walls.
BUG FIX - Improved navigation mesh, should help a lot to reduce AI getting stuck.
BUG FIX – The main cause for AI getting stuck was when they had line of sight of a player but could not reach that location. Now after 5 seconds, if they can’t reach the player, they will resume a wandering state.
ADDED - In my attempt to make a smarter AI, they can now open and close doors and can follow you in POIs. This function is disabled on player build bases however, they will not be able to open your doors. I plan to get feedback from players in the next few days about this, perhaps it makes it too difficult to evade them but seems strange that they just stop at the doors the way they did.

Other Bug Fixes:

BUG FIX - removed some floating props hovering above the water where some old islands were located.
BUG FIX - A desk was removed by mistake in a house resulting in a computer floating in thin air.
BUG FIX - Spelling mistake in a quest description, Gather Supplies.
BUG FIX - When aiming the bow and scrolling a weapon with the mouse, field of view would remain zoomed in.

Notes: 

Players may see some floating loot boxes in Warehouse POIs. I removed a desk and lowered the boxes to the ground but in older save files, I save the state of the boxes sp they are still in their original locations.

Also know that AI also have hearing sense and not only line of sight. They can hear you reload guns etc so that may be a reason why AI seems to not forget where you are and resume wandering again after 5 seconds.

notes.title: Experimental V6.01 UPDATE
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Experimental V6.01 is now available in a beta branch. To access it, right click the game in your Steam library and hit properties. There you will find a BETAS tab, select Experimental V6.01 and launch your game as usual. Once everything is debugged and adjusted/balanced, we will deploy it to the public branch. This version have many huge changes to the gameplay and under hood so their may be some bugs still.

A new game will be required, all older saved games will not work. Please report all bugs, comments and suggestions via the “Bugs/Fixes Thread” here on Steam.

Cheers!

[b][i]Map and Environment:[/i][/b]

We have spent a large portion of time on level design. Most Islands have been remodeled, some new ones added and some removed from the game. 

-	Dead Island is now much larger (starter island)
-	A new desert biome Island has been added (Dry Island)
-	Removal of Treasure, Frost and Drake Islands
-	The old Skull and Betrayal Islands have been merged with Dead Island 
-	2 news Islands have now become Skull and Betrayal
-	Addition of some small towns and the beginning of a road network
-	All friendly AI such as the Trader and Arms Dealer are no longer on Trader Island. (More info on AI below)
-	Removal of ferries to encourage the use of vehicles more often.
-	More caves have been added including on Dead Island, however only iron. For other resources players still need to access the caves on other Islands. Oil Shale exclusive caves in the desert biome.
-	2 new palm trees in the desert biome that give 10 wood and 10 plant fiber. (A few scattered on the shores of other Islands)
-	2 new cactus plants in the desert Biome that give 3 plant fiber and 2 Prickly Pear Fruits.  (A few scattered on the shores of other Islands)
-	Prickly Pear fruit acquired from cactus plants yield 6 carbs, 12 hours perish time
-	Desert Biome temperature adjusted to be hot
-	Removed small pine bushes that give plant fiber.
-	All trees now give 5 Plant Fiber when cut down.

The game now has 4 Friendly AI and the addition of a new and improved humanoid Aggressive AI.

-	Trader: now spawns randomly in a barn on Dead Island
-	Arms Dealer: Now spawns randomly in a store on Skull Island
-	Mechanic: Spawns randomly in a garage on Dead Island
-	Pharmacist: Spawns randomly in a pharmacy on Dead Island
-	Aggressive AI now called Guards (not hunters anymore) roam the forests and patrol the towns. AI respawn once killed even in the towns, unlike in previous version where they did not.  Thanks to Iron Belly Studios, they are developing our new AI and we are starting to deploy some of their work in this next version of the game. Although we are deploying just the basic versions of these new AIs, they now move smoother, smarter, reload their guns and not have endless ammo in their guns. They can also retreat when low on health and can call other close by AI to come assist them. We will be constantly improving upon this base AI over the next few updates.

-	Addition of drivable cars that can be purchased from the Mechanic for Gold.
-	Changes to how the Boat is crafted. You now need to purchase a Boat Hull from the mechanic.
-	Changes to how the Helicopter is crafted. You need to purchase certain components from the Mechanic.

notes.title: V3.01 is now public !!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Experimental V3.01 will now be pushed to the public branch. Thank you to everyone that helped debug it. Below is a complete list of all changes and additions. 

A fresh start will be needed to play this new version without issues. If you already have save files from the experimental branch, these will work fine. 

Please report all bugs via the “Bugs/Fixes Thread” here on Steam.

Cheers!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31137298/c3c7eee7ffa32c7e8fe047c62cb4ca3247cb1cd6.png[/img]
Quests/Game Modes:
I have added many new quests and eliminated some of the old ones. I will not list all the changes to the quest here because I prefer it remains a surprise till you actually play and do them. However, there is now a lore and story to the game and the quests will reflect that. 

I have also added 3 Game Modes to the new game creation page:

1)	Story Mode with Tutorials: (Default Mode and full story experience with all the tutorial quests.)
2)	Story Mode: (Full story experience without the tutorial quests.)
3)	Full Sandbox: (Full game with no quests at all, just a survival experience. All quest reward related items like the Schematics and Blueprints will be in the Trader chest on game start, so go pick them up there. Also, all ferry points will be unlocked.)

Game Lore:
Something had to give. We just never expected everything to go at once. The greed and arrogance of an invading force is now ruling us.

A once peaceful and resource filled set of Islands turned into darkness. They have poisoned the air and call themselves the “Reborn Militia”. They show little to no mercy and our towns are collapsing one after the other like blood-soaked dominoes. Their motive for all this terror you wonder? To gorge us of all our natural resources and make a profit. With many either dead or held captive, we find a group of rogue fighters called the “Hunters”. They serve all masters but belong to none. They are simply guns hired by the Reborn Militia to help settle their disputes.

Then there is us, a small group that has risen to the occasion. We are the outcasts, the resistance, the ones that will take back what is ours. We will keep fighting, not for God, not for justice, not even for a better world. We fight to survive.

And we will not stop. Not until the last barrel of oil is burnt, the last bullet spent. As long as they remain here and try to take our land we will spill blood over it. A war is coming and we have front-row seats.

Other changes and addons:
CHANGE - Removed the Guard POI Town on Betrayal Island and replaced with civilian POI Town.
CHANGE - Trees made larger to give a greater dense forest feel in some areas.
CHANGE - Guards now have foot step sounds.
CHANGE - Arms Dealer is now a women named Julia.
CHANGE - Electrical Parts crafting moved from the Workbench to the Control Panel.
CHANGE - Helipad to now be crafted in the new Metal Machine crafting station.
CHANGE - Furnace to now be crafted in the new Metal Machine crafting station.
CHANGE - Bellows recipe changed to need 5 leather and hide instead of 10.
CHANGE - Forge no longer requires Mechanical Parts to craft.
CHANGE - Adjusted several buy and sell prices of items at the trader.
CHANGE - Locate the workshop blueprints quest was changed, is no longer spawned in a random motel room. It is now part of a quest from Stan and found in a store on Skull Island.
CHANGE - Reduction in the length of night time. Sunset starts at 8pm (total darkness at 10pm). Sunrise at 2am (total daylight at 4am). So only 4 hrs of total darkness.
ADDED - Added some Patrol Guards at each POI on the map, including on Dead Island (starter island).
ADDED - Map of the Islands, there is a tab in the inventory to open it. It has no information other than Island names, an attempt for new players to have an idea as to what Island is where.
ADDED - Craftable Scrap Plastic Item.
ADDED - Metal Machine crafting station.
ADDED - Friendly AI that give out tasks and quests. (Stan, Rick, Jack and Mark)
ADDED - New ferry point that gets unlocked later in the game called the Resistance Post.
ADDED - Salt water bottle Item. Need to use empty glass jars in the ocean to fill it with salt water.
ADDED - Salt Item.
ADDED - PVC Resin Item.
ADDED - New ambient sound in caves.
ADDED - Water dripping in Caves.
ADDED - Night time ambient sound.
ADDED - Full controller support. if your game is already installed, you will likely need to reset all your controller key bindings. Any new installs, will have the correct default keys.
BUG FIX - Could not drop items from the inventory on the boat.
BUG FIX - Could not shoot arrows from the boat.
BUG FIX - Could not land Copter on Blood Island Helipad.

notes.title: V1.02 is now Public !!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Experimental V1.02 will now be pushed to the public branch. Thank you to everyone that helped debug it. Below is a complete list of all changes and additions. 

A fresh start will be needed in order to play this new version without issues. Your old save games will load but you will not have access to certain things.

Please report all bugs via the “Bugs/Fixes Thread” here on Steam.

Cheers!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31137298/03e859fcf717211333194f2f0b8af121afefbad4.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31137298/d16d1579f6a1fb755ba3c2567839706c2fb52545.jpg[/img]
[b][i]POI Update:[/i][/b]
ADDED - New POI (Motel)
ADDED - New POI (Coffee Shop)
ADDED - New POI (Gas Station)
ADDED - New POI (Shop)
ADDED - New POI (2 types of Apartment Buildings)
ADDED - New POI (Camp Sites)
ADDED - Props to current POIs, beds, fridges, couches and much more.

[b][i]AI Mechanics:[/i][/b]
CHANGE - Human AI will no longer run in a straight line to chase the player, instead they will randomly run at you at an angle.
CHANGE - Human AI will now react when getting shot, they will try and take cover or move away from your line of fire.
CHANGE - Shooting Human AI will alarm other close by AI to also chase and attack players.
CHANGE - Head shots with all but the Pistol gun projectile will result in a one shot kill. (2 shots for the pistol)
ADDED - 10% Critical Strike chance which inflicts more damage with firearms. (25% for the Shotgun)
ADDED - Human AI now have a chance to miss you when shooting. A small random rotation was added to fired projectiles.
ADDED - A minimum and maximum damage was added to all guns. This means that your shots fired will inflict random damage.
ADDED - UI message with damage info. Players will know how much damage a projectile made, if it was a head shot or critical strike.
CHANGE - Trees and other landscape objects will not block the line of sight of Hunters. For example, hiding behind a tree will no longer trigger the hunter to no longer see you, he will keep chasing and attempt to get into a position where he can shoot you.

[b][i]Quest System:[/i][/b]
CHANGE - Reworked the quest system. Only one quest active at a time, no more need to switch between active quests. Furthermore, quest will now auto complete. If a Forge for example is already crafted when the quest comes up, auto completion and reward given.
CHANGE - Some players are having a hard time locating and killing all the quest AI such as Guards and Elite Guards. To fix this problem, we have reduced the number of AI needing to be killed and the balance will be removed from the map after quest completion. ADDED - Sell Stews to Trader quest. (25 Meat Stews)

REMOVED - Mine Cobalt Quest.
REMOVED - Gather 3K Coins quest.
REMOVED - Kill 150 Hunters quest.
REMOVED - Kill 250 Hunters quest. 
REMOVED - Craft a Helipad quest.

ADDED - Workshop Building that can be crafted when the Workshop Blueprint is found.
ADDED - Fishing Boat Vehicle.
ADDED - Shipyard Crafting Station, to craft the boat and creates a reserved area in the water for the ship to be teleported back after death.
ADDED - Turbine Machine crafting station.
ADDED - Craftable wind turbines, provide constant power.
ADDED - Repair Bench that can be placed in the Workshop. Will be able to repair guns but will be a maximum of 3 repairs per weapon.
ADDED - Furniture Bench crafting station (to craft furniture for your base)
ADDED - Workshop Bench crafting station.
ADDED - Craftable Couch
ADDED - Craftable Table

ADDED - Craftable Bookcase
ADDED - Craftable Leather Chair
ADDED - Craftable Dining Room Chair
ADDED - Craftable Rug
ADDED - Craftable Cabinet

ADDED - Repair Kit item to repair weapons with on the Repair Bench.
ADDED - Workshop Blueprint Item.
ADDED - Machining Schematic Item.
ADDED - Turbine Schematic Item.
ADDED - Boat Schematic Item.

CHANGE - Map was modified, Skull and Mount Island are reduced in size.
CHANGE - Large reduction in the number of caves, also helped with performance and promotes the use of the Helicopter to find them. Also, caves reset daily so no more need for hundreds of caves.
ADDED – Oil Shale exclusive cave now on Drake Island.
ADDED - 2 exclusive Titanium caves now on Mount Island.
ADDED - New Island added called Coby Island (Coby because you primarily find Cobalt there). Furthermore, you can find 2 cobalt exclusive caves there.
REMOVED - Ferry on Gold Island.
REMOVED - Blocking volumes around Betrayal Island, no more restrictions to go to that Island.
REMOVED - Cobalt and Oil Spawning on Starter Island, with the boat now, players can get around to other islands to find them.
REMOVED - Ferry Point on Betrayal Island.
REMOVED - Blocking Volumes around Starter Island.
REMOVED - Exclusive Oil and Cobalt caves.

ADDED - A Chest next to the trader. Some quest rewards will be placed there for players to pick up.
ADDED - Player drops his backpack on death now but also added a setting to enable/disable the drop of backpacks on death.

The default setting will be 50%, meaning a 50/50 chance of the AI moving but can be set to 0% (never move) or 100% always move.
CHANGE - RAM performance optimization, game now uses 4GB instead of 6.5GB.
CHANGE - Reduced Jump height
ADDED - Bullet feedback when hitting ground, trees or any other mesh. (smoke effect)
CHANGE - Increased seed and sprout growth times on Plant Beds. Currently plants were taking 20 real time minutes to grow. I have changed it to take a complete game day for all but corn plants, which will take 2 game days approx.
CHANGE - Removed fertilizer from loots, will need to craft it in the Cement Mixer.
CHANGE - Added Both speed and camera view boat options to the menu controls.
CHANGE - Added "days" to the remaining fuel and burn time field in crafting stations and power generator.
CHANGE - Increased Gun Parts cost by the Arms Dealer.
CHANGE - Arms Dealer will now be unlocked once the Shipyard is constructed.
CHANGE - Added Cobalt and Oil Shale to all caves.
CHANGE - Kill 45 Guards quest on Betrayal Island no longer has the 3 Helicopter schematics to find, instead the trader will reward you with 1 of 3 schematics.
CHANGE - Kill 20 Elite Guards quest reward will now be given by the trader. (1 of 3 Helicopter schematics)
CHANGE - Workshop now also need the Machining Schematic item to craft.

[b][i]Bug Fixes:[/i][/b]
BUG FIX - Helicopter could not land on Trader Island
BUG FIX - Was able to use the ferry multiple times while in transit already to a ferry point. Was causing players to spawn under the map in some cases.
BUG FIX - A few caves were spawning only Titanium.
BUG FIX - A few trees were in the water.
BUG FIX - Reduced the size of Spawned Oil Shale, some were really large.
BUG FIX - Could not access the Helicopter cockpit and storage area.
BUG FIX - Could not harvest plants grown on plant bed.
BUG FIX - Could not access built objects like crafting stations and Helicopter without restarting the game.
BUG FIX - Oil Shale mesh was reduced in size but I had forgotten to also reduce the destructible mesh.
BUG FIX - Inventory would stay stuck if was open on death.
